threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'Dalston Junction' instead of just 'The Junction.' Everyone knows it's just Dalston now—welcome to the club.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham and overheard a couple arguing about who left the pizza slice out. Classic South London drama.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy in lederhosen juggling apples in Hermannplatz while a street musician played accordion—definitely a Neukölln day.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you sip on a coffee while watching a spontaneous dance-off in the U-Bahn station—so quintessentially Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate the BART delays; they know to grab a burrito before heading to the station, just in case.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 Mission at the right time today. A guy serenading us with an old guitar—other riders just vibing. Muni can surprise you sometimes.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists assume all Gràcia's squares are for lounging, but locals know that by sundown, plaça de la Virreina transforms into a lively performance stage.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their shyness when asking for directions at the metro station—locals just dive in confidently.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'excuse me' when passing folks on the path. Everyone else just power walks through like they own the pavement.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week, and a guy was singing opera to the driver. Not a soul batted an eye—classic South London moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the guy at the corner Kiez cafe remembers your order but you still can’t recall his name. That’s when you know you’re home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you grab a döner at 3 AM and hear a techno beat pulsing from the kebab shop while bike messengers zip past.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they react to BART delays; the ones who shrug and carry on know the struggle, while the newcomers stress out over the inevitable.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in full dive gear board the 14 Mission today. He just stood there, fins on, totally unfazed by the stares. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all we eat is paella and tapas, but a proper Gracià breakfast is a xuixo and café amb llet from the corner bakery.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell the newcomers by their puzzled looks when the tram screeches to a halt unexpectedly; locals just roll their eyes and keep scrolling on their phones.
